# Mubarak Shajahan — MK Comics

> Personal portfolio of Mubarak Shajahan (Mohammed Mubarak, முகமது முபாரக்), Senior Software Engineer at Galent, Chennai, India. Full-stack + AI: React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, AWS, LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows. The site is written as a comic book; every number and quote on it is real.

Career start: 21 June 2021. Senior Software Engineer at Galent (May 2026 – present); before that five years at Incresco (June 2021 – May 2026): Software Development Engineer → SDE 1 → SDE 2, building AI and full-stack platforms for Global University Systems. B.Tech in Information Technology, Sri Krishna College of Technology, Coimbatore (2018–2022, CGPA 8.01/10). Writes for 22,000+ developers on LinkedIn (10M+ impressions) about JavaScript, React and AI.

Proof, all on the page: sole engineer on EF Academy's primary digital presence (1.25M+ monthly users, 23+ languages); replaced a licensed TIBCO integration pipeline with AWS Glue before the contract ended ($24,000 → $840 a year, a 96.5% cut); AI document processing with GPT-4 Vision + OCR (17+ document types at 95% accuracy, manual entry −70%, processing 7×); Chrome extensions saving admins 3–5 hours a day at 99.9% uptime; nine named testimonials quoted verbatim.
